subject.title: [Feature]: Run channel command and session-context QA through canonical scenarios

question: Should this protected maintainer-authored QA migration stay as backlog, be split by channel, or be explicitly promoted as one cross-channel refactor?
rationale: The work is clear and aligned, but the `maintainer` label and maintainer authorship intentionally pause ClawSweeper automation until a maintainer chooses scope and timing.

options.title: Keep As Protected Backlog
options.body: Leave this issue open for maintainer scheduling until someone explicitly promotes the QA migration.

options.title: Split By Channel
options.body: Create narrower Telegram and WhatsApp follow-ups if the combined migration is too broad for one review cycle.

options.title: Promote One Refactor
options.body: Explicitly queue one bounded PR covering the listed scenario IDs, CLI delegation, and proof updates.

recommendation.title: Keep As Protected Backlog
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open for maintainer scheduling until someone explicitly promotes the QA migration.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the issue and the prerequisite live-adapter PR that defines the intended migration seam.
